meta.description: P6-13.5 Pipeline Execution Status vs Recommendation Validity Matrix

pipeline_execution_status.SUCCESS: The pipeline completed all data loading, factor calculation, and portfolio optimization steps without crashing.
pipeline_execution_status.LIVE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: Critical APIs failed or returned empty data, and no valid prices/volumes were loaded. Execution halted.
pipeline_execution_status.PARTIAL: The pipeline completed execution, but some non-critical data sources failed and fell back to stale cache or fallback logic.

recommendation_validity_status.REAL_RECOMMENDATION: The recommended portfolio was generated entirely from valid, real point-in-time and market data. Safe to execute.
recommendation_validity_status.DATA_INCOMPLETE_NO_VALID_RECOMMENDATION: The recommended portfolio could not be validated with real data due to mock data injection or insufficient real candidate universe depth. Unsafe to execute.

mappings.description: Standard successful run with real data and sufficient depth.
Pipeline runs, but cannot populate the TOP 5 portfolio with real candidates due to mock data filtration or missing tickers.

mappings.condition: All candidates fail price, volume, or core validation checks
mappings.description: Critical API failure resulting in empty price/volume matrices.
